turns.text: What price do we need on each bike we still sell for a 40% margin at standard cost?
Round them up to end in .99.
What do the .99 endings add to revenue against the exact 40% prices, at FY2025 volumes?

csvChecks.ask: bike_prices.csv with columns product_id,name,standard_cost,price_40_margin,price_99: every bike still on sale (category Bikes, no SellEndDate), current standard cost, the price for exactly 40% margin rounded to the cent, and that price rounded up to the next price ending in .99
